goal: Allow RPC callers to receive feerates in sat/vB rather than BTC/kvB
Eliminate manual conversions and sub-sat rounding errors in downstream tools
reviewability: The author agreed to minor enum and note cleanups but nothing invalidates review
agreement: Substantive support for adding backwards-compatible sat/vB reporting (musaHaruna, willcl-ark)
Concept approval without stated reasons (jonatack, w0xlt)
Objections about float math, negative rates, and mixed units were resolved (maflcko, w0xlt)
Resolved objection warning against ever changing default units due to API breakage (glozow)

categories.name: rpc
why: P3 because downstream tooling broadly uses sat/vB and risks rounding errors converting BTC/kvB
The change is an optional parameter and is deferrable since existing conversions still work
